aggregation: FPS = 1000 / median of five repeat mean latencies (ms)
scope: GPU-resident input through complete evaluation-mode model encode_decode, including 512x512 logit interpolation; no disk I/O, preprocessing, host/device transfer or argmax
flops: MMEngine FlopAnalyzer, one multiply-add counted as one operation; per-image GFLOPs; fused attention matrix products counted explicitly
custom_flops_note: FEM-Lite: same-padding convolution counted as output elements times per-filter kernel size; real selective scan core 5*B*D*L*N plus B*D*L for the skip; radix-2 FFT estimate 4*N*log2(N) per complex transform plus 2*N for inverse normalization. One MAC = one counted operation. Elementwise activations and data movement not supported by MMEngine are excluded for all models.
